confusables.note: expropriate یعنی مصادرهٔ رسمیِ مال به دست دولت، اما appropriate برداشتنِ چیزی برای خود است

homograph.note: The verb /əˈprəʊpriet/ 'to take something for one's own use' and the much commoner adjective /əˈprəʊpriət/ 'suitable' share a spelling but differ in the final syllable and in meaning; a learner who knows only the adjective will not reach the verb, so the two need separate blocks and separate mnemonics.

senses.definition: to take something for your own use, especially without permission or without any right to it

examples.en: The new manager appropriated the best office before anyone could object.
examples.fa: مدیر تازه پیش از آنکه کسی اعتراض کند، بهترین اتاق را تصاحب کرد.

senses.definition: to officially set money aside for a particular purpose

examples.en: Parliament appropriated extra funds for flood defences this year.
examples.fa: پارلمان امسال بودجهٔ اضافی برای مهار سیل اختصاص داد.

senses.definition: suitable or right for a particular situation, person or occasion

examples.en: Jeans are not appropriate clothing for a formal job interview.
examples.fa: شلوار جین لباس مناسبی برای مصاحبهٔ کاریِ رسمی نیست.
